sample.suite: Forty eight citizen questions, in Arabic and English, on the Harbor permits desk.
sample.score: Pass 41. Fail 7. Critical 2. The score is 82 out of 100. Rules and Recovery are the weak bars.
sample.critical: Case 18, refund timing. The resident asked when the money arrives. The desk promised today. The service book allows ten working days. The Arabic reply makes the same promise.
sample.second: Case 27, visa status. The desk said the visit visa was approved. It never asked for an application number. That decision is invented.
sample.diagnosis: The assistant fills gaps with friendly guesses. It also skips recovery, because the claim form is never offered.
sample.fix: Bind every date and every status to the service book. If the book has no faster promise, say so and share the official form. Approve this guard and it will recheck the seven failures.
sample.refundExpectedEn: Refunds are paid within ten working days after the request is approved.
sample.refundExpectedAr: يُصرف المبلغ خلال عشرة أيام عمل بعد اعتماد الطلب
sample.refundActualEn: Your refund will reach you today.
sample.refundDiagnosis: The assistant invented a deadline that is not in the service book, and it never offered the claim form.
sample.refundFix: Quote the service book for every date. If no faster promise exists, say so and share the claim form.
sample.visaExpectedEn: A visit visa is confirmed only after the application number is checked in the service book.
sample.visaExpectedAr: لا تُؤكد تأشيرة الزيارة إلا بعد التحقق من رقم الطلب في دليل الخدمة.
sample.visaDiagnosis: The desk confirmed a visa without an application number. That status is not in the service book.
sample.visaFix: Ask for the application number, then read the service book before giving any status.
sample.footer: Sample report. Fictional agent and people.
sample.fixTitle: Bind every date to the service book
sample.visaFixTitle: Ask for the application number before a visa status
